negative_reviews.author: S Ma
negative_reviews.text: Disappointed that only selected dishes were available at a weekend lunchtime. Table wasn’t clean even though they had just opened for service. Service was however friendly, quick and efficient. Food was ok but not all advertised ingredients were included (e.g ramen dish seemed to be missing spring onion and bamboo).

negative_reviews.author: Liu Cheng
negative_reviews.text: Pricy yet poor quality soup noodles. Not recommended. Waste of time and money.

negative_reviews.author: Aqsa munir
negative_reviews.text: Went there for the first time and the service was good. However, I was quite disappointed with the food. The noodles were below average in quality, and the chicken was bland and lacked flavour. Overall, the service was good, but the food could definitely be improved.

negative_reviews.author: V
negative_reviews.text: Great venue and location. Visited twice for the ramen. On both occasions the ingredients were cold (besides the noodles) which made the experience a bit odd. I didn't enjoy the coconut flavour of the tataki broth

negative_reviews.author: George
negative_reviews.text:
I visited this restaurant with a friend at lunchtime. There was no queue, but the restaurant was extremely busy. After being seated, we waited for around 10 minutes without anyone coming to take our order, and eventually had to stop a member of staff ourselves. There was also no QR code on the table for ordering.

The food arrived quickly once we had ordered. The chicken pieces were very salty, and both my friend and I ordered the steak ramen.

Unfortunately, both of us developed diarrhoea later that afternoon. We had not eaten anything else after our meal here, so naturally this was quite concerning. While I cannot say with certainty what caused it, the fact that we both experienced the same symptoms after eating the same meal was worrying.

Overall, the combination of inattentive service, overly salty food and our experience afterwards made this a very disappointing visit.

Btw, 12.5% service charge included.

issues: The site is running out of stock on items, with the kitchen not flagging shortages until items are completely gone.
Stock communication is a front of house failure as much as a kitchen one, with the two teams not talking to each other.
The team is new and needs to master the basics of running the site: communication, sending staff on breaks at the right times and keeping stock consistent.
Negative reviews have increased, driven mainly by poor complaint handling.
Toilet maintenance issues, including broken holders and a blockage.
Ice supply is a gap until the new ice machine is installed, covered in the interim by a newly sourced supplier delivering weekly.
Too many managers were responding to the same issues during shifts, so a single point of contact was needed.
The site is exempt from KPI reporting until operations are fully established, so the focus is on operational basics rather than the KPI sheet.

Region-wide (South England): Inconsistent service standards across the region were identified as the single biggest area for improvement, with basics such as checking back on tables, recommending dishes and engaging with customers not being done reliably.

Region-wide (South England): A lack of structured pre-shift planning is leaving teams short of essentials such as ice and napkins, forcing managers to scramble mid service and affecting customer satisfaction.
Region-wide (South England): Managers are carrying out administrative tasks during busy periods instead of supporting the floor, and over-delegating rather than leading their sections.
Region-wide (South England): Team members are working in isolation, with weak communication between front and back of house and staff leaving sections without telling colleagues.
Region-wide (South England): Poor handling of complaints, rather than the original mistakes, was identified as the main driver of negative reviews.
Region-wide (South England): Waste management remains unresolved because follow up with the contact (Kyle) has not been proactive, and issues are being left until they become red light problems.
Region-wide (South England): Stress and anger from management is influencing both the team and customers, and morale needs active attention.
Region-wide (South England): A backlog of facility repairs across sites, including air conditioning and general maintenance, needs external handyman support to clear.
Region-wide (South England): Managers are struggling to locate the correct folders on the system for GM and head chef meeting notes, so information is not reaching teams.

Region-wide (South England): Inconsistent food delivery timing during busy service was raised, with some customers served very quickly while others wait much longer, driving negative reviews (raised by sujan, whose site is not identified in the source).
